source.hard_rule_3: Records the backend does not emit are gaps, not assumptions.

verb_legend.missing_data: the exact quantity/field the room cannot show
verb_legend.source_of_truth: the durable plane the value should be derived from (a real path/table/endpoint)
verb_legend.source_plane: ledger | job-attempt-table | lease-settlement | queue | supervisor | control-packet | run-ledger | measurement-rule | website-lab | none
verb_legend.granularity: per attempt | per step | per job | per model | per task | per session | per run | per arm | per campaign | fleet
verb_legend.update_cadence: event | attempt-end | run-close | enqueue | poll:Ns | on-demand | per-campaign | static

cadence_vocabulary.event: written/derived at the moment a state transition occurs and pushed via SSE (/api/events) or visible on the next packet read
cadence_vocabulary.attempt-end: written when a step/attempt completes (the attempt ledger record)
cadence_vocabulary.run-close: written at the run's terminal transition
cadence_vocabulary.enqueue: set once when the job is materialized into the queue
cadence_vocabulary.poll:Ns: recomputed periodically (e.g. projection refresh); value is a lower bound between refreshes
cadence_vocabulary.on-demand: computed at query time from durable records
cadence_vocabulary.per-campaign: recomputed when a campaign/arm set closes
cadence_vocabulary.static: a calibrated/modeled input that changes only on explicit reconfiguration
